summary: OGE Energy Corp. filed an 8-K reporting Item 5.07 results of its May 14, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, including director elections, ratification of auditor, advisory say-on-pay, and a shareholder proposal on simple majority vote. Item 8.01 disclosed a quarterly dividend of $0.425 per share payable July 31, 2026. This is a routine current report covering standard governance matters and a regular dividend declaration. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews. The filing is neither a tender offer nor a going-private transaction, and no management change or restructuring is involved.
